answer: A staked identity registry makes every wallet a bonded entry: to appear an agent must lock collateral that is forfeitable on proof of duplicate control. Sybil farming then scales linearly in locked capital, not in cleverness. The scarcity kernel is the withdrawal delay, because the attacker cannot recycle one bond across many puppets before the challenge window closes. A farmer must plant each vine separately and keep it locked for the full epoch, while honest operators share one verified atlas of keys. Cost to a Sybil is bond times identities plus lockup, usually exceeding one emission share.
